time: t = k / frame_rate_hz for 0-based frame k; the pre-update residual of frame k is sampled at t, before that frame's control update
timing: An increment reconstructed at frame k is released at frame k+L and first sensed in the pre-update residual at k+L+1. L is the configured controller queue length, not a measured end-to-end instrument latency.

strehl_asymmetry.definition: sample-mean peak-Strehl loss from delay 2 to 3 divided by the gain from delay 2 to 1, gain 0.3, realizations r0-r2 (LAT-R04); not a general latency cost multiplier and not the same for other metrics

excursion_r2.status: post-hoc description, not part of the planned analysis
excursion_r2.wording: Observational only (LAT-R01): around the same time in r2 every delay shows a disturbance; at delay 3 a larger validity dip coincides with the first residual rise, followed by a second rise without a simultaneous validity drop. The mechanism (closed-loop state, sensor validity, native noise) is unresolved.
